prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need (industry, channels, budget, goals, timeline, and whether you want a local partner or are fine with a remote shop). I can, however, help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me produce a ranked shortlist with pros/cons and ballpark pricing:

Questions
- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, lead generation, e-commerce sales, PR, content, SEO, social media, paid ads, etc.)
- What industry are you in (B2B, healthcare, education, nonprofit, retail, professional services, real estate, etc.)?
- Monthly/annual budget or budget range for agency services?
- Project type and timeline: ongoing retainer, specific campaign, one-off project, or website build?
- Do you prefer an agency physically in Maryland (for in-person meetings) or is remote OK?
- Company size / revenue and marketing team size (do you need an agency to act as your whole marketing department or to supplement in-house staff)?
- Any must-have capabilities (e.g., HubSpot expertise, Shopify, paid-media management, PR contacts)?

How I’ll help once you answer
- Provide a shortlist of 4–6 Maryland-based agencies (or a mix of local + high-fit remote firms) ranked for fit.
- Summarize each agency’s strengths, notable clients/case studies, likely monthly cost range, and questions to ask them.
- Suggest a simple RFP/brief you can use and a short vetting script to screen calls.

If you’d rather start on your own, here are quick criteria and a vetting checklist to evaluate agencies:
- Proven results: case studies with metrics (CAC, ROI, conversion lifts).
- Relevant industry experience and similar client size.
- Clear scope, deliverables, and KPIs in writing.
- Transparent reporting cadence and tools (analytics access).
- Team structure and dedicated point of contact.
- References from past or current clients.
- Trial/initial project option or short-term contract flexibility.
- Cultural fit and communication style.

Tell me the answers to the questions above (or your top priorities) and I’ll build a tailored shortlist.
